commit_message:
[Build][AMDGPU] Use bitcode from the official ROCM distribution (#25133)

With the sunset of the old artifacts from
`shark-infra/amdgpu-device-libs`, migrate to LLVM bitcode blobs from the
official distribution. The version shall be pinned in
`build_tools/third_party/amdgpu_device_libs/rocm_package.json`.

This increases the bitcode download to 146Mb (in comparison, the WASI
SDK weighs in at <120Mb). Considering we're only using less than 1Mb,
that's unfortunate, but at the moment it's the only way to use the
official maintained source.

Fixes #25131.

Assisted-by: Codex
